validity.researcher_notes: Progress is a real line from Yamburg to the Western border, described by Russian and Ukrainian Wikipedia and listed among the Ukrainian western corridor trunks by English Wikipedia. It is correctly a transmission trunk and is a separate string from P0768, not a duplicate. The recorded length 4590.7 km is not stated anywhere found. Both Wikipedia articles say 3473 km total with 1160 km in Ukraine. Capacity 26 bcm/y matches Russian Wikipedia, but English Wikipedia and a European Geopolitical Forum page give about 28 bcm/y. Diameter 1400 mm and the 1988 build year are confirmed. Owner and operator follow the usual Gazprom plus Ukrainian operator pairing for this transnational line.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Cannot tell. Russian transit through Ukraine ended on 1 January 2025 when the agreement between the Ukrainian operator and Gazprom expired. Ukraine imported 6.5 bcm of gas in 2025, mostly from Hungary and Poland, so the Ukrainian system is in use, but no page found names this line as carrying that gas. English Wikipedia lists Progress among the corridor trunks, with no statement on use after 2024. The status is left as operating and flagged for a person to decide between operating and idle. This covers the Ukrainian section.
